newsitem.title: USA: Huntsman says to buy Deerfield Plastics.
newsitem.headline: Huntsman says to buy Deerfield Plastics.

text.p: Huntsman Corp, the largest privately-held chemical company in the U.S., said it will buy Massachusetts-based Deerfield Plastics Co Inc in a transaction slated to close next month.

Deerfield, the largest independent U.S. producer of polyethylene films, has annual revenues of about $100 million. It has two manufacturing facilities with more than 140 million pounds of annual capacity.
Huntsman said the acquisition will give it 400 million pounds of total polyethylene film capacity, making it the fourth largest film producer in the U.S.

It is the first of two acquisitions that Huntsman was expected to announce soon. Chief Executive Officer Jon Huntsman told Reuters last month that the company also was planning to buy a major polymers unit of a publicly-held company.
